subject: question about Annotate internal nodes, image format

messages.author: 3ae2dd709f8948b6
messages.subject: question about Annotate internal nodes, image format
parts:
Hi everyone,

When annotating internal nodes with images, is it possible to use another format than png, like PS, SVG, tiff?
What are the image formats we can use?

Best regards,

Gabriel

messages.author: 3ae2dd709f8948b6
messages.subject: Re: question about Annotate internal nodes, image format
parts:
Hi again,

I have another question.
When I tried to annotate each internal node of my tree with a specific image, I reveived this error message:

Error in magick_image_readpath(path, density, depth, strip, defines) : rsession.exe: FailedToExecuteCommand `"gs" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=pngalpha" -dTextAlphaBits=4 -dGraphicsAlphaBits=4 "-r72x72" -g700x700 "-sOutputFile=C:/Users/gdupre/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpcr9OBa/magick-BzeGFnoDjtB2d-gLNHqcI90xnFU5B7Xh%d" "-fC:/Users/gdupre/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpcr9OBa/magick-6x27NZ3dkeTvVlW5rosmHYhiNwyKu28B" "-fC:/Users/gdupre/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpcr9OBa/magick-obHH4uToRmddo6pMnle2bkv8_I1wDKxV"' (Le fichier spécifié est introuvable. ) @ error/delegate.c/ExternalDelegateCommand/459 De plus : Warning message: Removed 518 rows containing missing values (geom_image).

Someone can help me with this?
My image files are in .ps format.

Best regards,

Gabriel

messages.subject: Re: question about Annotate internal nodes, image format
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for your response. So, you mean that the problem comes from an incompatible image format I used (.ps). Is that right?
I converted all of the image files to .png format, but there is still a problem:

```
Error : Can't join on `x$node` x `y$node` because of incompatible types. i `x$node` is of type <integer>>. i `y$node` is of type <character>>.
```

I am using a data set containing two variables, both in  "character" type, as follows:

```
'data.frame': 1148 obs. of 2 variables:
$ node : chr "Node10" "Node100" "Node1008" "Node1009" ...
$ images: chr "Node10_(reversed)_dp.ps_rss.png" "Node100_(reversed)_dp.ps_rss.png" "Node1008_(reversed)_dp.ps_rss.png" "Node1009_(reversed)_dp.ps_rss.png" ...
```
Where does the error come from?

Gabriel

Le jeudi 17 décembre 2020 à 16:56:25 UTC+1, guangc...@gmail.com a écrit :
if the image format is not supported, you should file an issue to the ggimage github repo.
